_: Hand-authored ARPAbet for words the CMU dictionary does not carry and no derivation rule can reach — mostly loanwords and coinages. Every one of these is a word Barsmith itself prompts with, so a missing pronunciation is a dead rhyme panel on a word we chose. Keys prefixed with _ are ignored; entries here override CMU and any derived form, so this is also the place to fix a derivation that came out wrong. Stress digits: 1 primary, 2 secondary, 0 unstressed. Re-run scripts/build-rhyme-data.py after editing.
